title.label: Don’t use, impedes on free speech

content.label: I ended up switching back to Apple’s version. I was making comments about a boomer, sucking the life out of our country and that impeded on their safety rules. Make that make sense. It was a really cool solution. I enjoyed using it, but after the last couple updates they put so many safeguards on this that it’s worth worthless unless you fit the the woke narrative and only say things against Christians or white males then you don’t have anything to worry about.
